readings.Aries: You thrive in motion. Today the most important motion is internal. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Taurus: Your instinct to stay is correct. The reason you're staying is worth examining. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Gemini: Your flexibility is a gift to others and sometimes a burden to yourself. Draw a line. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Cancer: The mood has been difficult and you've been managing it alone. That arrangement can change. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Leo: Your instinct to lead is correct. Your instinct to control the entire outcome needs recalibrating. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Virgo: Your standards are high because you know what's possible. Most people don't. This is lonely sometimes. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Libra: The beauty you seek in your environment is also something you create in everyone around you. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Scorpio: The loyalty you extend to your own past version of events — check whether those events still hold. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Sagittarius: You've outgrown something. The exit is available. Give it a moment of ceremony. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Capricorn: There is something in your past you carry as evidence of who you are. Is the evidence still current? Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Aquarius: The future belongs to what you're becoming. The present belongs to who you already are. Don't lose track. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Pisces: Your imagination is the realest thing about you. Don't let the practical world convince you otherwise. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
